definitions.name: G0B.SUM
definitions.note: sum of a numeric Vector as a bare scalar

definitions.name: G0B.MEAN
definitions.note: arithmetic mean of a numeric Vector, bare scalar

definitions.name: G0B.DEV
definitions.note: Vector of each number minus the mean

definitions.name: G0B.MAX
definitions.body: 'G0B.R' BIND G0B.R G0B.R 0 GET [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: largest element of a non-empty numeric Vector, bare scalar

definitions.name: G0B.MIN
definitions.body: 'G0B.R' BIND G0B.R G0B.R 0 GET [ MIN ] FOLD
definitions.note: smallest element of a non-empty numeric Vector, bare scalar

definitions.name: G0B.NORMALIZE
definitions.body: 'G0B.N' BIND G0B.N G0B.N G0B.MIN - G0B.N G0B.RANGE /
definitions.note: rescale each number to (x - min) / (max - min)

definitions.name: G0B.WORDS
definitions.note: split a String on single spaces into a Vector of words

definitions.name: G0B.CAP
definitions.body: CHARS 'G0B.C' BIND G0B.C [ 1 ] TAKE [ UPPER ] MAP G0B.C [ 1 ] DROP CONCAT JOIN
definitions.note: upper-case the first letter of a String

definitions.name: G0B.UNWORDS
definitions.note: join a Vector of Strings with single spaces

solutions.text.acronym: G0B.WORDS [ CHARS 0 GET ] MAP JOIN UPPER
